jobs.beschreibung:
Bist du bereit, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs mitzugestalten?
Der Zahlungsverkehr befindet sich im größten Wandel seit Jahrzehnten. Neue regulatorische Anforderungen, digitale Ökosysteme und innovative Technologien verändern die Art, wie Menschen und Unternehmen bezahlen.
Genau hier setzt unser Team an.
Gemeinsam mit Zentralbanken, Geschäftsbanken und weiteren Finanzinstituten entwickeln wir Strategien und begleiten die Transformation moderner Payment-Landschaften – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Ob Digitaler Euro, Instant Payments, Embedded Finance, Wallet-Lösungen oder KI-gestützte Innovationen: Wir helfen unseren Kunden dabei, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs aktiv zu gestalten.
Deine Mission
Als Digital Payments Consultant / Manager gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung des europäischen Payments-Marktes aktiv mit. Gemeinsam mit einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Team aus Strategie-, Fach- und Technologie-Experten entwickelst du zukunftsweisende Lösungen für unsere Kunden und begleitest ihre Transformation.
Du analysierst Markt- und Technologietrends, entwickelst innovative Geschäfts- und Operating-Modelle und berätst unsere Kunden bei strategischen Fragestellungen rund um den Zahlungsverkehr sowie während der Umsetzung ihrer Transformation – immer mit dem Ziel, messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.
Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du Verantwortung für einzelne Projektmodule oder leitest Projektteams, entwickelst Kollegen weiter und unterstützt den Ausbau unseres Payment-Geschäfts.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dein Arbeitsumfeld aktiv mit. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, individuellen Weiterbildungsangeboten und einem inspirierenden Team, das Vielfalt und Innovation lebt.
Das erwartet dich
Gestalte den Zahlungsverkehr von morgen. Du entwickelst innovative Strategien und Geschäftsmodelle für Zentralbanken, Geschäftsbanken und weitere Finanzinstitute und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Payment-Landschaften zukunftssicher auszurichten.
Führe unsere Kunden durch anspruchsvolle Transformationen.
Du begleitest unsere Kunden von der Strategieentwicklung über die fachliche und technische Konzeption bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Transformationsprogramme.
Treibe Innovationen voran.
Du analysierst Markttrends, identifizierst neue Potenziale und entwickelst daraus innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden sowie neue Beratungsangebote für Accenture.
Präge die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs.
Du arbeitest an Themen wie Digitaler Euro, Instant Payments, Embedded Finance, Open Finance oder Wallet-Lösungen wie EPI/ Wero und bringst technologische Innovationen wie KI, Cloud und Blockchain gezielt in Kundenprojekte ein.
Verbinde Strategie und Technologie.
Du arbeitest eng mit Expert:innen für Strategie, Business und Technologie zusammen und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachliche Exzellenz mit erfolgreicher Umsetzung verbinden.
Übernimm Verantwortung und entwickle Menschen weiter.
Als Manager führst und entwickelst du Projektteams, förderst Kolleg:innen und gestaltest den weiteren Ausbau unserer Payments Community aktiv mit.
Das ist genau dein Ding? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der Accenture Payments Community. Übernimm eine zentrale Rolle in einem internationalen Team aus Strategie-, Fach- und Technologieexperten und vertiefe gleichzeitig deine eigene Expertise. Arbeite an der Gestaltung innovativer Technologien, Geschäftsmodelle und maßgeschneiderter Payment-Strategien und trage dadurch dazu bei, die Finanzwelt nachhaltig zu prägen und zu verändern.
Darauf freuen wir uns
Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich.
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Beratung, einer Bank, einem Zahlungsdienstleister oder im Bereich Payments und Digital Currency.
Selbstständiges Arbeiten, Eigenverantwortung und Proaktivität zeichnen dich aus.
Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an innovativen Payments-Lösungen zu Digitaler Euro, Wallet-Lösungen, Instant Payments , Embedded Finance und Technologien wie KI, Blockchain & Cloud sowie die Fähigkeit, diese gezielt in der Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung einzusetzen.
Eine aufgeschlossene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit, die analytisch denkt und innovative Lösungen entwickelt.
Deine Teamfähigkeit und kooperative Arbeitsweise.
Deine Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän zu überzeugen.
Was wir dir bieten
Spannende Strategie- und Transformationsprojekte bei führenden Finanzinstituten sowie Zentralbanken.
Die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft des Zahlungsverkehrs aktiv mitzugestalten und an den wichtigsten Innovationen der Branche zu arbeiten.
Früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und – je nach Erfahrung – Teams, Kundenbeziehungen und neue Marktangebote weiterzuentwickeln.
Individuelle Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie ein umfassendes Mentoring-, Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsangebot.
Individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell in Voll- oder Teilzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, dort zu arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst – sei es an einem Accenture-Standort, remote oder direkt beim Kunden vor Ort.
Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und persönliches Wachstum fördert.
Events, die Erfolge feiern.
Du und Accenture
In dieser Rolle bist du Teil unserer Accenture Payments Community – einem Team, das Strategie, Technologie und Umsetzung verbindet. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir führende Finanzinstitute dabei, den Zahlungsverkehr neu zu denken und nachhaltige Wettbewerbsvorteile zu schaffen.
Dabei arbeiten wir interdisziplinär, international und nah an den Themen, die den Markt bewegen. So gestaltest du nicht nur Projekte, sondern auch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Payment-Geschäfts und die Zukunft der Finanzindustrie.
Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Grossartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.
Dein Kontakt
Noch Fragen offen? Schreib uns an recruiting_germany@accenture.com.
Wir freuen uns auf dich!
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
Erklärung zur Chancengleichheit am Arbeitsplatz
Wir sind der Meinung, dass niemand aufgrund seiner Andersartigkeit diskriminiert werden sollte. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden unabhängig von Alter, Rasse, Glaubensbekenntnis, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, Abstammung, Behinderung, Veteranenstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, genetischen Informationen, Familienstand, Staatsbürgerschaft oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Kriterien getroffen. Unsere große Vielfalt macht uns innovativer, wettbewerbsfähiger und kreativer und hilft uns, unsere Kunden und unsere Gemeinschaften besser zu betreuen.

jobs.beschreibung:
Drive the growth of a leading SAP Utilities platform and shape digital energy solutions. Lead strategic sales and expand the market across Germany and Europe.
Your Mission
You lead the commercial success of a flagship SAP Utilities platform — driving go-to-market strategy and personally originating complex, multi-million euro sales opportunities across Germany and CEE. This is a hybrid role: part GTM architect, part hands-on deal originator. You will shape the commercial framework the wider sales team operates within, and personally lead strategic pursuits as the platform expands.
You will work closely with the Product Manager and pre-sales function to define licensing models, modularisation entry points, and a repeatable GTM motion — building the commercial infrastructure of a scaling platform inside a firm with genuine assets, client relationships, and brand behind it.
At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.
What you can expect
Define the commercial model.
Develop and own the licensing framework across on-premise, SaaS/multi-tenant, and SI-led models; set pricing principles and guardrails so the sales team can operate consistently
Build the GTM architecture.
Define the Ideal Customer Profile across Germany and CEE, shape the modularization strategy with the Product Manager, and map the competitive landscape
Lead high-value sales pursuits.
Personally originate and close complex deals, typically exceeding €10M in contract value, including EU public procurement and tender processes
Expand and leverage your network.
Build pipeline from Accenture's existing client base and net-new targets; use your utility industry network and presence at E-world, BDEW, SAP for Utilities, and CEE industry forums
Define the CEE entry strategy.
Identify priority markets, assess partner vs. direct models, and lead the first pursuits in the region
Professionalize the commercial motion.
Systematise what is currently deal-by-deal selling: qualification criteria, proposal standards, pricing governance, and pipeline forecasting
Feed market intelligence back into the product.
Translate prospect objections, competitor moves, and lost deal analysis into structured input for the Product Manager and Product Owner
What we are looking forward to
10+ years in enterprise software or platform sales - with
a demonstrable track record closing complex deals in the utility or energy sector
Deep functional knowledge of SAP IS-U or SAP S/4HANA Utilities - sufficient to be credible with a utility CIO or Head of Billing from day one
An active, senior network in DACH utility procurement, IT leadership, or transformation decision-making
Experience selling both on-premise and SaaS/managed service models - and a genuine understanding of the commercial and contractual differences between them
Comfortable operating at CIO, functional VP, or programme director level - whether selling to that audience or having been that audience
Able to build commercial structure from scratch — not just operate within an existing playbook
Fluent in German and English - additional CEE language capability is a plus
Candidates who will stand out have done one or more of the following: personally built or materially shaped a SaaS recurring revenue model for an enterprise software product; worked across Germany and at least one CEE market; or have past professional experience at SAP AG, a SAP Value Added Reseller, or in a utility CIO/programme director capacity.
What we offer you
A senior role with direct ownership of commercial strategy and platform growth — with Accenture's client relationships, brand, and delivery capability behind you
Competitive compensation benchmarked to ISV and product-company norms, including performance-based incentives
Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
Access to Accenture's executive network and global career development infrastructure
Comprehensive benefits including pension, wellbeing programmes, and learning platforms
You and Accenture
In this role, you’ll be part of Accenture Sales. Connecting engineering and manufacturing with data and technology, we help our customers realign their product and value chains. With smart factories, digital twins, and networked manufacturing processes, we support them in embracing the future.
The Accenture culture: This is where YOU make the difference
Your skills, your character, and your ambitions make you unique. And when a wide variety of talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something great emerges: ideas that make a difference in the world. That is why, at Accenture, we believe in diversity and the freedom to develop. Create a work environment in which you thrive. With tasks that matter to you. With a workload that suits you. And with a way of working that aligns with your goals. How you network, continue learning, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We help you shape it the way you imagine it.
Contact Us
Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com.
We look forward to your application.

{"jobPostingInfo":{"id":"485b33a3925a1001143a7c5039df0000","title":"SAP Utilities Sales Director (all genders)","jobDescription":"

Drive the growth of a leading SAP Utilities platform and shape digital energy solutions. Lead strategic sales and expand the market across Germany and Europe.

Your Mission

You lead the commercial success of a flagship SAP Utilities platform — driving go-to-market strategy and personally originating complex, multi-million euro sales opportunities across Germany and CEE. This is a hybrid role: part GTM architect, part hands-on deal originator. You will shape the commercial framework the wider sales team operates within, and personally lead strategic pursuits as the platform expands.

You will work closely with the Product Manager and pre-sales function to define licensing models, modularisation entry points, and a repeatable GTM motion — building the commercial infrastructure of a scaling platform inside a firm with genuine assets, client relationships, and brand behind it.

At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.

What you can expect

  • Define the commercial model.
    Develop and own the licensing framework across on-premise, SaaS/multi-tenant, and SI-led models; set pricing principles and guardrails so the sales team can operate consistently

  • Build the GTM architecture.
    Define the Ideal Customer Profile across Germany and CEE, shape the modularization strategy with the Product Manager, and map the competitive landscape

  • Lead high-value sales pursuits.
    Personally originate and close complex deals, typically exceeding €10M in contract value, including EU public procurement and tender processes

  • Expand and leverage your network.
    Build pipeline from Accenture's existing client base and net-new targets; use your utility industry network and presence at E-world, BDEW, SAP for Utilities, and CEE industry forums

  • Define the CEE entry strategy.
    Identify priority markets, assess partner vs. direct models, and lead the first pursuits in the region

  • Professionalize the commercial motion.
    Systematise what is currently deal-by-deal selling: qualification criteria, proposal standards, pricing governance, and pipeline forecasting

  • Feed market intelligence back into the product.
    Translate prospect objections, competitor moves, and lost deal analysis into structured input for the Product Manager and Product Owner

What we are looking forward to

  • 10+ years in enterprise software or platform sales - with
    a demonstrable track record closing complex deals in the utility or energy sector

  • Deep functional knowledge of SAP IS-U or SAP S/4HANA Utilities - sufficient to be credible with a utility CIO or Head of Billing from day one

  • An active, senior network in DACH utility procurement, IT leadership, or transformation decision-making

  • Experience selling both on-premise and SaaS/managed service models - and a genuine understanding of the commercial and contractual differences between them

  • Comfortable operating at CIO, functional VP, or programme director level - whether selling to that audience or having been that audience

  • Able to build commercial structure from scratch — not just operate within an existing playbook

  • Fluent in German and English - additional CEE language capability is a plus

Candidates who will stand out have done one or more of the following: personally built or materially shaped a SaaS recurring revenue model for an enterprise software product; worked across Germany and at least one CEE market; or have past professional experience at SAP AG, a SAP Value Added Reseller, or in a utility CIO/programme director capacity.

What we offer you

  • A senior role with direct ownership of commercial strategy and platform growth — with Accenture's client relationships, brand, and delivery capability behind you

  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to ISV and product-company norms, including performance-based incentives

  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

  • Access to Accenture's executive network and global career development infrastructure

  • Comprehensive benefits including pension, wellbeing programmes, and learning platforms

You and Accenture

In this role, you’ll be part of Accenture Sales. Connecting engineering and manufacturing with data and technology, we help our customers realign their product and value chains. With smart factories, digital twins, and networked manufacturing processes, we support them in embracing the future.

The Accenture culture: This is where YOU make the difference

Your skills, your character, and your ambitions make you unique. And when a wide variety of talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something great emerges: ideas that make a difference in the world. That is why, at Accenture, we believe in diversity and the freedom to develop. Create a work environment in which you thrive. With tasks that matter to you. With a workload that suits you. And with a way of working that aligns with your goals. How you network, continue learning, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We help you shape it the way you imagine it.

Contact Us

Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com.

We look forward to your application.

jobs.beschreibung:
As the Ecosystem Business Development Director (all genders), you are a growth focused professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.
You have an understanding of business development phases of a sales cycle, including account development, opportunity identification, relationship development, and qualification by applying strategic sales processes .
You have a specialization in the Ecosystem Partners technologies and offerings. You develop strategic relationships with the Ecosystem Partner to keep abreast of all the latest developments in their offerings.
Your focus is on origination of opportunities with the said Ecosystem Partner using your sales expertise and specialized knowledge.
You will drive origination and lead with the value of the Ecosystem Partner + Accenture for our clients.
You develop primary relationships with key Accenture and your Ecosystem Partner account personnel, most significantly client account leads, to identify and qualify opportunities to solve client pain points and growth objectives utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest Ecosystem Partners technologies and accelerators. Additionally, you will support the account personnel in building relationships with key buyers through bringing business and technical expertise to business development conversations and qualify and progress originated deals.
You are integrated as one Accenture with the Accenture Commercial leaders to ensure the best of One Accenture is brought to our clients and ensure that the Partner Offerings you are specialized in are socialized with the leaders in your Market as well as surrounded with the winning team and win strategy.
Your focus on the Ecosystem partnership is a key objective and ensuring that the relationship is nurtured and a culture of trust is established, to ensure successful deal flow, client satisfaction and trusted partnerships. To win deals our partners and customers (internal and external) must love us.
The work:
• Prospects new opportunities proactively through client account leads and direct client contact
• Drive a partner-aligned co-sell motion, including go to market development, alignment & customer targeting, joint opportunity origination & qualification and regional communications, awareness & enablement
• Create awareness of the Ecosystem Partners incumbency, joint solutions offerings, and capabilities with all relevant Accenture and Ecosystem Partner stakeholders
• Engage in holistic partner planning including overall strategy, go to market development and alignment, financial success, tailored campaigns and joint client engagements
• Identify complex technology business problems / opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs and Accenture + Ecosystem Partner solutions that drive in year ROI and have an in quarter revenue opportunity
• Create differentiated opportunities based on Ecosystem Partner offerings and joint go-to-market
• Develop thought leadership to raise awareness of joint value proposition. Enable the Ecosystem Partner and Accenture teams on our unique joint value proposition, communicate investment levers and manage partner investments
• Interact with senior management levels at clients, within Accenture and the Ecosystem Partner to develop, align and execute pursuit strategies, develop client contact plans and relationship maps, and apply industry-leading transformation and operations strategies and practices
Here's what you need
• Relevant degree in Economics, IT, Industrial Engineering or vocational training
• Minimum of around 8 years of Business Development expertise in the professional services space
• Channel and Ecosystem partner management experience and ways of working
• Fluent German and English language skills
• Client facing experience and willingness to travel within Germany
Bonus points if you have
• Previous experience in conceptualizing, planning, and implementing transformation programmes
• Experience working within G2000 customers
• Experience with C Level client relationship building and relationship management
• Ability to discuss latest technology hot topics on the fly with VP clients and working level technical resources
• Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision making abilities
• Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility and character
You and Accenture
In this role, you’ll be part of the Global Accenture Sales Group. We leverage the full spectrum of digital technologies to simplify our clients’ everyday operations and lead their businesses into the future.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU Make the Difference
Your skills, personality, and ambitions make you unique. And when diverse talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something extraordinary happens: ideas that truly make an impact. That’s why Accenture champions diversity and individual freedom. Create a work environment where you thrive—with tasks you care about, a workload that suits you, and a working style aligned with your goals. How you network, learn, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We’re here to help you shape it the way you envision.

Still have questions? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team by email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com or by phone at 00800 45045045.
We look forward to your application!

jobs.titel: EU Export Controls Compliance Counsel (all genders)
jobs.beschreibung:
Internationale Exportkontrolle ist dein Fachgebiet? Du analysierst komplexe regulatorische Fragestellungen gerne präzise, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst rechtliche sowie Compliance-relevante Sachverhalte klar und nachvollziehbar auf Papier? Dann gestalte mit uns zukunftssichere Export-Compliance-Strukturen in einem dynamischen, internationalen und technologiegetriebenen Umfeld.
Deine Mission
Als Compliance Manager EU Export bist du zentrale Ansprechperson für exportkontrollrechtliche Fragestellungen innerhalb Europas. Du bewertest regulatorische Anforderungen, unterstützt Geschäftsbereiche, Legal- und Compliance-Teams bei komplexen Sachverhalten und entwickelst praktikable Lösungen, die sowohl den rechtlichen Anforderungen als auch den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens gerecht werden.
Dabei verbindest du fachliche Expertise mit einem ausgeprägten Sinn für Details. Erfolgreiche Compliance beginnt mit Liebe zum Detail. Deshalb analysierst du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen präzise, dokumentierst Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und stellst sicher, dass unsere Compliance-Prozesse auditfest, belastbar und nachhaltig in der Organisation verankert sind.
Die Rolle eignet sich insbesondere für Juristinnen und Juristen, die Freude an der Analyse komplexer regulatorischer Fragestellungen haben und ihre rechtliche Expertise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld einbringen möchten. Aufgrund unseres vielfältigen Projektportfolios erwarten dich regelmäßig anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen an der Schnittstelle von Recht, Technologie, internationalem Handel und regulierten Industrien.
Mit deiner sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise, deinem Urteilsvermögen und deiner Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich aufzubereiten, trägst du dazu bei, Risiken zu minimieren, sichere Geschäftsentscheidungen zu ermöglichen und nachhaltige Compliance-Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.
Das erwartet dich
Export Compliance rechtssicher umsetzen und weiterentwickeln
Du unterstützt die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung globaler Exportkontrollrichtlinien und -prozesse innerhalb Europas. Dabei sorgst du für rechtssichere, praktikable und skalierbare Lösungen, die den regulatorischen Vorgaben und den geschäftlichen Anforderungen gleichermaßen gerecht werden.
Komplexe regulatorische Fragestellungen analysieren
Du analysierst nationale, europäische und internationale Exportkontrollvorschriften und bewertest deren Auswirkungen auf Geschäftsmodelle, Projekte und operative Abläufe. Auf dieser Grundlage entwickelst du fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen und unterstützt bei der rechtlichen Bewertung regulatorischer Risiken.
Rechtliche Bewertungen und Compliance-Dokumentation erstellen
Du erstellst rechtliche Bewertungen, Richtlinien, Governance-Dokumente, Risikobewertungen, Entscheidungsvorlagen und weitere Compliance-Unterlagen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Bewertungen, Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen klar dokumentiert, nachvollziehbar begründet und für interne sowie externe Prüfungen belastbar aufbereitet sind.
Fachbereiche, Legal und Compliance beraten
Du berätst Business-Teams, Führungskräfte, Legal, Ethics & Compliance sowie weitere Stakeholder zu Fragen rund um Exportkontrolle, Trade Compliance und handelspolitische Vorschriften. Dabei übersetzt du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen für die Praxis.
Compliance in Geschäftsprozesse integrieren
Du entwickelst und implementierst Compliance-Pläne und stellst sicher, dass Exportkontrollanforderungen nachhaltig in Geschäfts-, Delivery- und Wachstumsprozesse integriert werden. Dabei begleitest du auch neue Geschäftsmodelle, internationale Projekte und Expansionen mit Blick auf exportkontrollrechtliche Anforderungen.
Regulatorische Entwicklungen bewerten
Du beobachtest relevante europäische, US-amerikanische und internationale Gesetzesänderungen, analysierst deren Auswirkungen auf das Unternehmen und leitest gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern geeignete Maßnahmen und Strategien ab.
Darauf freuen wir uns
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise als Volljurist/in, oder ein vergleichbarer juristischer Abschluss
Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Exportkontrolle und Trade Compliance in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse der deutschen und europäischen Exportkontrollvorschriften, einschließlich Dual-Use- und Militärgüterregelungen
Erfahrung in der rechtlichen Bewertung regulatorischer Anforderungen, Risiken und Handlungsoptionen
Ausgeprägte Liebe zum Detail sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Sachverhalte präzise zu analysieren, strukturiert zu dokumentieren und auditfest aufzubereiten
Hervorragende schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch mit der Fähigkeit, klare und strukturierte rechtliche sowie Compliance-bezogene Analysen für Führungskräfte, Behörden und Auditoren zu erstellen
Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Legal, Ethics & Compliance, Risk Management und Business-Teams bei sensiblen oder risikobehafteten Fragestellungen

Internationale Exportkontrolle ist dein Fachgebiet? Du analysierst komplexe regulatorische Fragestellungen gerne präzise, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst rechtliche sowie Compliance-relevante Sachverhalte klar und nachvollziehbar auf Papier? Dann gestalte mit uns zukunftssichere Export-Compliance-Strukturen in einem dynamischen, internationalen und technologiegetriebenen Umfeld.

Deine Mission

Als Compliance Manager EU Export bist du zentrale Ansprechperson für exportkontrollrechtliche Fragestellungen innerhalb Europas. Du bewertest regulatorische Anforderungen, unterstützt Geschäftsbereiche, Legal- und Compliance-Teams bei komplexen Sachverhalten und entwickelst praktikable Lösungen, die sowohl den rechtlichen Anforderungen als auch den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens gerecht werden.

Dabei verbindest du fachliche Expertise mit einem ausgeprägten Sinn für Details. Erfolgreiche Compliance beginnt mit Liebe zum Detail. Deshalb analysierst du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen präzise, dokumentierst Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und stellst sicher, dass unsere Compliance-Prozesse auditfest, belastbar und nachhaltig in der Organisation verankert sind.

Die Rolle eignet sich insbesondere für Juristinnen und Juristen, die Freude an der Analyse komplexer regulatorischer Fragestellungen haben und ihre rechtliche Expertise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld einbringen möchten. jobs.beschreibung:
As a Contract Manager, you will play a critical role in the successful delivery of large-scale infrastructure and data centre projects by managing the commercial and contractual aspects of complex construction contracts. Working closely with project teams, procurement, legal, contractors, and suppliers, you will ensure contractual compliance, mitigate commercial risk, and support the delivery of projects on time and within budget.
Key Responsibilities
Manage the full lifecycle of construction and infrastructure contracts, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, company policies, and applicable legislation.
Act as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned projects, providing contractual advice and support to internal stakeholders.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to support successful project delivery.
Support procurement activities by providing commercial and contractual input during tendering, bid evaluation, contract negotiation, and contract award.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer construction contracts, framework agreements, work orders, and call-off agreements.
Lead the commercial management of contracts, including variations, change orders, compensation events, claims, extensions of time, and dispute resolution.
Identify, assess, and manage contractual and commercial risks, ensuring appropriate mitigation measures are implemented throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor contractor performance against contractual requirements and ensure commercial obligations are delivered in line with project objectives.
Support project controls by monitoring commercial performance, project budgets, forecasts, commitments, and cost reporting.
Ensure all contractual documentation, notices, correspondence, and commercial records are maintained accurately and in accordance with company governance.
Work collaboratively with Procurement, Commercial, Legal, Project Management, and Cost Management teams to ensure consistent contract administration and commercial best practice.
Identify opportunities to improve commercial performance, contract processes, and supply chain efficiency across infrastructure and data centre projects.
Promote a culture of collaboration, compliance, integrity, and health and safety across all commercial activities.
Demonstrable experience in Contract Management within large-scale infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or data centre construction projects.
Bachelor's degree in Law, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong experience administering complex construction contracts throughout the project lifecycle.
Proven expertise in contract change management, claims management, variations, commercial negotiations, and dispute avoidance.
Strong understanding of construction contract forms such as NEC and/or FIDIC. Experience with EPC, EPCM or Design & Build contracts is highly desirable.
Sound knowledge of commercial governance, procurement principles, and contract risk management within major capital projects.
Commercially astute, with experience supporting project cost management, forecasting, financial reporting, and budget control.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying commercial risks and opportunities.
Fluent English is essential. German language skills are advantageous but not essential.

Support project reporting by documenting estimate revisions and providing clear explanations for cost changes.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of estimating processes, tools, and best practices.

Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or a comparable technical discipline.
Minimum of 8–10 years of professional experience in cost estimating, including experience working on multidisciplinary projects.
Strong experience in pre-contract estimating for large infrastructure, energy, industrial, or commercial construction projects.
Excellent knowledge of estimating software and cost databases (e.g. CostX, Candy, Causeway, or comparable solutions).

You will play a key role in schedule development, progress monitoring, risk analysis, change management, and performance reporting, while supporting the successful delivery of complex infrastructure, energy, or industrial projects.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and manage project schedules covering all phases of the project lifecycle.
Prepare and implement project planning strategies that support project objectives, milestones, and contractual deadlines.
Develop and maintain network logic schedules using recognised planning methodologies.
Establish project baselines, manage schedule updates, and obtain the necessary approvals throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress by updating schedules with actual performance and forecasting remaining activities and durations.
Produce schedule analyses, progress reports, and critical path assessments, highlighting risks, delays, and recommended mitigation measures.
Work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Commercial, Construction, Clients, and Contractors to monitor project performance and support informed decision-making.
Perform schedule risk analyses and develop contingency plans to minimise programme delays.
Develop, implement, and maintain Earned Value Management (EVM) systems to measure project performance and progress.
Apply practical construction and planning knowledge to identify schedule constraints and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure robust change management processes are applied, maintaining a clear audit trail for all programme revisions.
Support continuous improvement of planning processes, methodologies, and reporting standards.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior planners where appropriate.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
Proven experience as a Planning Engineer or Project Planner within infrastructure, construction, engineering, energy, or industrial projects.
Strong experience using Primavera P6 (Version 8.2 or later), including resource planning and cost loading where applicable.
Experience developing and maintaining complex, logic-driven project schedules.
Sound understanding of project planning principles, critical path analysis, schedule forecasting, and project controls.
Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills with the confidence to challenge project assumptions and facilitate progress discussions.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.
Experience working within multidisciplinary and matrix project environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working under NEC3 or similar international contract forms, with a good understanding of planning and programme requirements.
Formal qualification or certification in project planning, scheduling, or project management.
Practical on-site construction experience.
Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM), schedule risk analysis, and change control processes.

jobs.beschreibung:
Du möchtest die Energiewende aktiv mitgestalten und dabei für Struktur und Transparenz in komplexen Infrastrukturprojekten sorgen? Als Consultant im Bereich Dokumentenmanagement unterstützt du Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber bei der professionellen Steuerung ihrer Projektdokumentation – von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Dabei arbeitest du an zukunftsweisenden Projekten rund um Netzausbau und erneuerbare Energien und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen jederzeit nachvollziehbar, qualitätsgesichert und verfügbar sind.
Deine Mission
Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Einführung, Optimierung und Steuerung von Dokumentenmanagement-Prozessen in anspruchsvollen Infrastruktur- und Energieprojekten. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Dokumente über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg revisionssicher, strukturiert und effizient verwaltet werden. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Projektteams, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern sorgst du für reibungslose Abläufe, hohe Datenqualität und die Einhaltung relevanter Standards und Compliance-Anforderungen.
Das erwartet dich
Dokumente im Griff
Du steuerst Projektdokumente über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg – von der Erstellung über Freigaben und Versionskontrollen bis hin zur Archivierung. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Dokumente jederzeit vollständig, aktuell und nachvollziehbar sind.
Prozesse, die funktionieren
Du entwickelst Dokumentenmanagement-Prozesse, Richtlinien und Standards weiter und begleitest deren Umsetzung im Projektalltag. Zudem unterstützt du bei der Administration und kontinuierlichen Optimierung der eingesetzten Systeme und Tools.
Qualität sichern, Risiken minimieren
Du führst Qualitäts- und Vollständigkeitsprüfungen durch, stellst die Einhaltung von Compliance- und Dokumentationsvorgaben sicher und bereitest relevante Unterlagen für Audits, Reviews und Abnahmen vor.
Beratung & Zusammenarbeit stärken
Du unterstützt Projektteams bei Fragen rund um Dokumentenmanagement und Document Control, führst Schulungen durch und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Planungs- und Genehmigungsteams zusammen, um dokumentationsbezogene Anforderungen erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Darauf freuen wir uns
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise im Ingenieurwesen, Bauingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet, oder eine passende kaufmännische bzw. technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung.
Du bringst mindestens zwei bis vier Jahre Berufserfahrung im Dokumentenmanagement bzw. Document Control mit – idealerweise in Bau-, Infrastruktur- oder Großanlagenprojekten.

As a Project Controls Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring successful project delivery by providing leadership across all Project Controls disciplines. You will be responsible for project planning, scheduling, cost management, forecasting, progress measurement, reporting, and performance analysis, enabling informed decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.
Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will support complex capital projects from bid through execution while driving operational excellence, continuous improvement, and delivery certainty.
Your Responsibilities
As a Project Controls Manager, you will:
Lead and coordinate all Project Controls activities, including planning & scheduling, cost control, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, and earned value management.
Develop, maintain, and control integrated baseline schedules and project control systems throughout the project lifecycle.
Prepare and present weekly and monthly project performance reports, including schedule status, cost performance, forecasts, variance analysis, and key project risks.
Partner with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, and Project Management teams to develop realistic execution strategies and project schedules during bid and delivery phases.
Implement and maintain robust progress measurement and Earned Value Management (EVM) methodologies to monitor project performance and support proactive decision-making.
Analyse project performance, identify schedule and cost deviations, and develop mitigation and recovery plans.
Ensure compliance with client requirements, contractual obligations, company standards, and established Project Controls processes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by standardising tools, methodologies, reporting frameworks, and best practices across projects.
Collaborate with regional and global Project Controls teams to share knowledge, lessons learned, and drive operational excellence.
Lead and mentor Project Controls professionals on large and complex programmes where required.
Support project governance, internal audits, and executive reporting activities.
Perform additional responsibilities aligned with business and project needs.
Your Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Project Controls, Project Planning, or Project Management within EPC, infrastructure, energy, industrial, or capital project environments.
Experience within Nuclear Decommissioning or another highly regulated industry is considered a strong advantage.
Strong expertise in project scheduling, cost control, forecasting, risk management, and Earned Value Management (EVM).
Proven experience supporting projects throughout the full project lifecycle—from tender and planning through execution and close-out.
Demonstrated ability to deliver accurate project reporting and provide strategic insights to senior stakeholders.
Experience leading multidisciplinary Project Controls teams on complex projects.
Excellent analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills within international project environments.
Proficiency with industry-standard Project Controls tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP and Power BI is an advantage.
Fluent English is required. German language skills (minimum B2) are desirable and may be required depending on the project.

Lead the delivery of complex data centre projects throughout the full project lifecycle, from feasibility and design through construction, commissioning, and project close-out.
Advise clients during the project initiation phase, supporting strategic decision-making and recommending delivery approaches that align with business objectives.

Oversee project reporting, ensuring timely communication of project status, risks, financial performance, and key milestones to clients and senior stakeholders.
Promote a culture of excellence in Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ), ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company standards.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact throughout all project phases.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by sharing best practices, lessons learned, and innovative delivery approaches.

Several years of professional experience in Project Management within construction consultancy, engineering consultancy, or contractor environments.

As a Risk Manager, you will help clients successfully deliver complex capital projects and programmes by establishing and embedding effective risk management practices throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with project teams and stakeholders to identify, assess, quantify, and manage project risks, enabling informed decision-making and improving project outcomes.
You will support the delivery of projects across highly regulated and technically complex industries, applying industry best practices and contributing to the continuous improvement of enterprise and project risk management capabilities.
As a Risk Manager, you will:
Design, implement, and continuously improve project and programme risk management frameworks aligned with client requirements and industry best practices.
Facilitate qualitative and quantitative risk workshops with multidisciplinary teams and subject matter experts.
Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance project risk registers, risk dashboards, and other risk management documentation.
Review and challenge risk information to ensure data quality, consistency, and transparency for effective decision-making.
Drive the implementation and monitoring of risk mitigation actions, ensuring accountability across project teams.
Support project teams in defining measurable and effective mitigation strategies and management responses.
Perform Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRA) for cost and schedule using recognised risk analysis methodologies and software tools.
Analyse project risk exposure and provide recommendations to support project planning, forecasting, and contingency management.
Prepare high-quality risk reports, dashboards, and executive presentations using Microsoft Office and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
Collaborate closely with Project Controls disciplines—including Planning, Cost Management, and Project Management—to ensure alignment of project data and reporting.
Engage with clients, contractors, and supply chain partners to identify, assess, and manage project risks throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management methodologies, tools, and governance processes across projects and programmes.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Risk Management, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
Professional experience in Project Risk Management across one or more industries such as Infrastructure, Energy, Utilities, Nuclear, Industrial, Transportation, or Construction.
Experience supporting projects throughout the full project lifecycle, from project development and design through execution and close-out.
Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, monitoring, and reporting.
Practical experience performing Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) for cost and schedule.
Proficiency with recognised risk management software such as Safran Risk, @RISK, PRA, or equivalent tools.
Experience using reporting and data visualisation tools including Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with project risk management standards and frameworks such as ISO 31000, APM Risk Management, Management of Risk (MoR), or comparable international methodologies.
Experience working within multidisciplinary Project Controls teams and collaborating with diverse stakeholders.
Strong analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and the ability to evaluate complex risk scenarios and their business implications.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain complex risk topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Membership of a recognised professional body such as the Institute of Risk Management (IRM), Association for Project Management (APM), or an equivalent organisation is advantageous.
Professional certifications such as APM Risk Certificate, Management of Risk (MoR), or comparable qualifications are desirable.
Experience in the Nuclear or other highly regulated industries is considered an advantage but is not essential.
Fluent English is required. German language skills (minimum B2) are desirable and may be required depending on the project.
Eligibility to obtain any project-specific security clearance required for client engagements.

jobs.beschreibung:
As a Quantity Surveyor, you will support the successful commercial delivery of complex capital projects by providing expert quantity surveying and cost management services throughout the project lifecycle. Working closely with clients, contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams, you will help ensure projects are delivered within budget, in accordance with contractual requirements, and with a strong focus on value, quality, and risk management.
You will contribute to the successful delivery of large-scale construction and infrastructure projects while driving commercial excellence and supporting informed business decisions.
Your Responsibilities
As a Quantity Surveyor, you will:
Prepare, manage, and monitor project cost plans, budgets, estimates, and financial forecasts throughout all phases of the project lifecycle.
Support procurement activities, including preparing tender documentation, evaluating bids, conducting commercial assessments, and assisting with contract award recommendations.
Administer construction contracts and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and commercial procedures.
Measure, value, and certify construction works, including interim valuations and final accounts.
Review, assess, negotiate, and manage variations, change orders, claims, and commercial risks.
Monitor project costs and financial performance, identifying cost risks, opportunities, and mitigation measures.
Prepare regular commercial reports, including cost reports, cash flow forecasts, commitment tracking, and cost-to-complete analyses.
Support value engineering and cost optimisation initiatives throughout design and construction.
Collaborate with Project Managers, Cost Managers, Project Controls, Engineering teams, contractors, and clients to ensure effective commercial management.
Maintain accurate project records, cost databases, benchmarking information, and historical cost data.
Ensure compliance with client governance, internal financial controls, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, sharing best practices and supporting the development of commercial processes.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Commercial Management, or a related discipline.
Professional experience in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or Cost Management within construction, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering projects.
Experience supporting projects across the full construction lifecycle, from pre-contract services through project completion and final account settlement.
Strong knowledge of cost planning, estimating, procurement, contract administration, change management, and commercial reporting.
Good understanding of standard forms of construction contracts (e.g. FIDIC, NEC, JCT, or VOB).
Experience preparing valuations, managing variations, claims, and final accounts.
Strong analytical, commercial, and negotiation skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while working effectively in multidisciplinary and international project environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with a client-focused mindset.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry-standard commercial and cost management software.
Professional membership with RICS, AACE International, or a comparable professional institution is desirable. Candidates working towards chartership are encouraged to apply.

Du hast dein Abitur oder deine Fachhochschulreife mit guten Noten abgeschlossen.

jobs.beschreibung:
Du liebst es, Dinge zu koordinieren, den Überblick zu behalten und Kunden mit exzellentem Service zu begeistern? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams in Hamburg und unterstütze uns dabei, reibungslose Abläufe zwischen Kunden, Produktion, Logistik und Einkauf sicherzustellen.
Deine Mission
Als Order Manager & Delivery Planning Senior Analyst (all genders) bist Du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und internen Fachbereichen. Du koordinierst den gesamten Auftragsprozess von der Bestellung bis zur Auslieferung, stellst eine zuverlässige Kommunikation sicher und sorgst durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise für hohe Kundenzufriedenheit und effiziente Abläufe im Sales & Operations Umfeld.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.
Das erwartet dich
Auftragsmanagement mit Überblick
Du bearbeitest Kundenaufträge von der Auftragserfassung bis zur Lieferung, prüfst Bestellungen auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit, erstellst Auftragsbestätigungen und sorgst für eine fehlerfreie Pflege aller relevanten Daten und Informationen in unseren Systemen.
Kundenservice auf Augenhöhe
Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, beantwortest Anfragen zu Bestellungen, Lieferterminen oder Portalthemen, bearbeitest eingehende E-Mails und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten schnelle und lösungsorientierte Antworten.
Koordination entlang der Lieferkette
Du arbeitest eng mit Produktion, Logistik, Einkauf und Finance zusammen, stimmst Liefertermine ab, klärst Abweichungen und unterstützt dabei, dass Kundenaufträge termingerecht und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
Daten & Dokumentation im Griff
Du verwaltest Auftrags-, Versand- und Rechnungsdokumente, stellst die Aktualität relevanter Informationen sicher und unterstützt bei Auswertungen, Reportings sowie administrativen Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft.
Verbesserung von Prozessen & Customer Experience
Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale in unseren Vertriebs- und Serviceprozessen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und trägst dazu bei, unseren Kunden ein professionelles, zuverlässiges und positives Serviceerlebnis zu bieten.
Darauf freuen wir uns
Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Vertrieb, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

YOU ARE
As a Principal AI Infrastructure Architect, you are the firm's most senior technical authority on compute infrastructure for large-scale AI and machine learning systems, bringing extensive experience as a lead and senior architect along with command over a broad landscape of technological options and the latest innovations that can be introduced into a solution. You have a proven track record of successfully designing and deploying large-scale infrastructure on which significant AI/ML solutions operate in production and demonstrably deliver business value — not just systems that perform, but systems that move the needle for the organizations they serve. You weigh and rationalize multiple viable architectures across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and model serving, making authoritative decisions tailored to each client's situation, standards, and strategic objectives, and you set the technical direction that senior and lead architects build upon. As a recognized expert across at least one hyperscaler cloud — and conversant across several — you bring deep, current knowledge of AI/ML services, accelerators, interconnects, and cost levers, and you continuously scan the horizon to identify promising emerging technologies and judge where and when they belong in a real solution. You are well known to our infrastructure partners and partnering organizations, maintaining strong relationships that give the firm early access, influence, and insight, and you represent the practice's technical credibility in those forums. Beyond architecture, you shape strategy and roadmaps, establish standards and reference architectures, mentor and elevate the architect community, and are ultimately accountable for ensuring the firm delivers AI/ML infrastructure that meets business SLAs, controls cost, scales to frontier workloads, and creates lasting business value.
THE WORK
Set the overarching technical vision and strategy for compute infrastructure supporting large-scale AI/ML systems, establishing the direction that senior and lead architects build upon.
Own the most complex, high-stakes architecture decisions across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and model serving, rationalizing multiple viable options and making authoritative choices aligned to client situations, standards, and strategic objectives.
Architect and hands-on prototype large-scale, cost-optimized compute and distributed training systems — building reference implementations, proofs-of-concept, and benchmarks to validate designs before they scale.
Define reference architectures, standards, and architectural patterns that scale across engagements, and personally implement the foundational tooling, infrastructure-as-code, and automation that anchor them.
Lead enterprise-scale architecture assessments and design reviews, getting hands-on in the environment to validate findings, profile real workloads, and demonstrate optimization opportunities.
Shape and steward the AI infrastructure roadmap and technology strategy, planning capacity, scaling, and technology evolution in step with long-term business goals.
Identify, evaluate, and hands-on pilot promising emerging technologies and innovations, building and testing them in real conditions to judge where and when they belong in a solution.
Drive hands-on performance and cost optimization of the computational stack, profiling GPU/compute utilization, tuning distributed training and model-serving workloads, and engineering improvements to meet SLAs while controlling cost.
Serve as the principal authority across hyperscaler cloud platforms, with current, hands-on expertise in AI/ML services, accelerators, interconnects, and cost levers, and breadth across multiple providers.
Lead deep, hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of the most complex issues across the stack — hardware, networking, software, and models — resolving the problems others cannot and codifying the fixes.
Cultivate and lead relationships with infrastructure partners and partnering organizations, securing early access, influence, and insight, and representing the practice's technical credibility in those forums.
Provide executive- and client-level technical advisory, translating complex infrastructure trade-offs into clear, defensible recommendations tied to business outcomes.
Define monitoring, observability, and reliability strategy across InfraOps and MLOps, and implement the instrumentation, SLAs, SLOs, and cost/performance governance for production AI/ML systems.
Ensure enterprise integration, security, compliance, and regulatory alignment of AI/ML infrastructure across the firm's solutions.
Mentor, elevate, and grow the architect community, developing senior and lead architects through hands-on pairing, design collaboration, and code/architecture reviews.
Champion cost-efficiency and value realization, ensuring infrastructure not only performs and scales but demonstrably moves the needle for the organizations it serves.
EDUCATION
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, related Engineering field
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION
Significant experience in coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting applications of AI/ML models; selecting, designing and infrastructure for deploying and running them on premise or on public cloud.
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning as a subject.
Strong understanding of computing infrastructure a subject, preferred knowledge of AI infrastructure.
Well versed and proven experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Kubeflow).
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Longstanding experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler platform for deploying large scale solutions.
Proven experience in leading and managing AI projects and teams.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Demonstrated experience in evaluating and selecting AI technologies and frameworks.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and drive project alignment.

Job Description
YOU ARE
As a Lead and Principal Infrastructure Architect, you own end-to-end responsibility for designing optimized compute infrastructure for large-scale AI and machine learning systems, including large-scale distributed training environments.
You are the authority who translates business goals, SLAs, and client standards into infrastructure architectures that perform at scale while being deliberately engineered for cost-efficiency. Drawing on deep experience, you weigh multiple viable solutions for any given problem — across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and model serving — and make rational, well-justified architectural decisions tailored to each client's situation, constraints, and standards. You architect and optimize the full computational stack for performance, power, cost, and scalability; design and tune large-scale GPU clusters and distributed training systems; and ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
As the recognized AI infrastructure expert in at least one hyperscaler cloud (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), you bring authoritative knowledge of that platform's AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, and cost levers, and apply it to deliver best-in-class solutions. Beyond design, you set technical direction and standards, lead and mentor engineers and architects, partner with clients and stakeholders to shape the infrastructure roadmap, and are ultimately accountable for delivering AI/ML infrastructure that meets business SLAs, controls cost, and scales to enterprise and frontier workloads.
THE WORK
Own the end-to-end architecture and design of optimized compute infrastructure for large-scale AI/ML systems, including large-scale distributed training environments, from concept through delivery.
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and model serving to make rational, well-justified decisions tailored to each client's situation and standards.
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation.
Drive architectural decision-making, documenting rationale, trade-offs, and assumptions so decisions are transparent, defensible, and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
Define and maintain the AI infrastructure roadmap, planning capacity, scaling, and technology evolution in step with business and product goals.
Architect and optimize the full computational stack for performance, power, cost, and scalability, ensuring infrastructure meets business SLAs while being deliberately engineered for cost-efficiency.
Design and tune large-scale GPU clusters and distributed training systems, including accelerator selection, interconnect/networking, and storage for high-throughput training workloads.
Serve as the authoritative AI infrastructure expert in at least one hyperscaler cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), applying deep knowledge of its AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, and cost levers.
Design deployment, automation, and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable, and scalable releases of AI systems, models, and data pipelines into production.
Establish AI monitoring and observability strategy across InfraOps and MLOps, defining SLAs, SLOs, alerting, and performance/cost tracking, and driving continuous optimization.
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments, ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, and adherence to regulatory and client standards.
Lead capacity planning and cost modeling, forecasting compute needs and engineering cost-efficiency into the architecture without compromising performance.
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes, translating requirements into actionable architecture and standards.
Set technical direction, standards, and best practices, mentoring engineers and architects and leading design and code reviews across the team.
EDUCATION
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, related Engineering field
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION
Solid background in coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting applications of AI/ML models; selecting, designing and infrastructure for deploying and running them on premise or on public cloud.
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning as a subject.
Strong understanding of computing infrastructure a subject, preferred knowledge of AI infrastructure.
Good proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Kubeflow).
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Significant experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler platform for deploying large scale solutions.
Proven experience in leading and managing AI projects and teams.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Demonstrated experience in evaluating and selecting AI technologies and frameworks.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and drive project alignment.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

jobs.beschreibung:
Deine Mission
Als Praktikant:in in unserem Team für Public Sector Strategy Consulting gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft des öffentlichen Sektors. Im Fokus deiner Beratungstätigkeit stehen strategische Grundsatzfragen und organisatorische Richtungsentscheidungen für die Verwaltung von morgen. So treibst du nicht nur die Modernisierung öffentlicher Organisationen voran, sondern schaffst nachhaltigen gesellschaftlichen Impact.
Hört sich schon mal gut an? Du hast 3-6 Monate Zeit und kannst bereits ab Oktober/November 2026 starten? Dann lese unbedingt weiter.
Das erwartet dich
Gestalte die Zukunft des öffentlichen Sektors
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team berätst du öffentliche Institutionen wie Ministerien oder staatliche Unternehmen zu zentralen Zukunftsthemen: von der Strategieentwicklung über die Neuausrichtung von Organisationen in Zeiten von agentischer KI bis hin zur Gestaltung komplexer Transformationsvorhaben – du setzt dich mit den aktuell größten Herausforderungen des Public Sectors auseinander, analysierst Zukunftstrends, bringst Innovationsimpulse ein und trägst zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen bei.
Übernimm Verantwortung und bringe dich aktiv ein
Als Praktikant:in führst du zum Beispiel qualitative und quantitative Analysen durch, recherchierst relevante (politische) Rahmenbedingungen und wirkst an der Entwicklung von Lösungskonzepten sowie Entscheidungsgrundlagen mit. Dabei arbeitest du an unterschiedlichen Arbeitspaketen mit – du wertest Informationen aus, bereitest Inhalte adressatengerecht auf und gestaltest innovative Workshops.
Arbeite und wachse in interdisziplinären Teams
Du arbeitest in interdisziplinär zusammengesetzten, diversen Teams – remote, im Office oder beim Kunden vor Ort. Dich erwartet ein leistungsorientiertes und analytisch geprägtes Umfeld, das Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist gleichermaßen fördert. Unser Team verbindet strategische Exzellenz mit dem Anspruch, echten gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert zu schaffen.
Darauf freuen wir uns
Du befindest dich mindestens im fünften Semester deines Bachelorstudiums oder im Masterstudium (alle Fachrichtungen willkommen)
Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Bezug zur Strategieberatung, dem öffentlichen Sektor oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
Du zeichnest dich durch analytische Schärfe, ein strukturiertes Denkvermögen sowie eine hohe Lernbereitschaft aus.
Du arbeitest sorgfältig, mit einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick.
Du hast Freude an einer teamorientierten Arbeitsweise und an der gemeinsamen Entwicklung innovativer Lösungsansätze.
Du überzeugst durch ein souveränes und empathisches Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.
Was wir dir bieten
Einen starken Teamspirit – geprägt von hoher Motivation, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und persönlicher Wertschätzung
Eine steile Lernkurve durch den Einsatz auf vielfältigen Projekten, regelmäßiges Feedback sowie Mentorings und Coachings
Ein breites Weiterbildungsangebot – u. a. mit zahlreichen Trainings zur Nutzung von KI
Regelmäßige Team- und Firmenevents, die Austausch und Vernetzung in unserer Community fördern
Zahlreiche Benefits, darunter Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote
Du und Accenture
In dieser Rolle bist du Teil von Accenture Strategy & Consulting. Der aktuelle Wandel eröffnet Unternehmen zuvor nie dagewesene Chancen. Mit ganzheitlichen Strategien helfen wir unseren Kunden, diese umfassend auszuschöpfen und sich neu zu erfinden.
Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Noch Fragen offen? Schreib uns an michael.bergmann@accenture.com

YOU ARE
You are a a strong individual contributor knowledge engineer growing into a team lead. You are well versed in the full knowledge graph development lifecycle. You formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, scalable AI and Knowledge Graph solutions, working hands-on across the lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, and deployment. You apply current methodologies, techniques, and algorithms with the right architecture, and begin to guide junior engineers on the project. You stay current with knowledge engineering, generative AI, LLM, and multi-modal models; look for opportunities to apply them to the problem at hand. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies as needed. You help articulate the value of generative AI and knowledge graph approaches for a given business problem. You share what they learn with the team. You collaborate with users, use case reps, engineers, architects, and UI designers to deliver their piece of an end-to-end solution.
Your Daily Work
Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture.
Design, develop, and implement AI and semantic solutions; ensure their work integrates cleanly with the broader system.
Work alongside the project team and delivery leads.
Build solid working relationships with client counterparts on their workstream.
Help assemble the supporting evidence for the recommended semantic layer solution.
Support Accenture sales efforts when called on.
Keep developing skills in cutting-edge Data & AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, and shares with the team.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus at least 3 of the following:
Experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL)
Experience in schema design, ontology management, and KG curation
Well versed in designing and developing KG solutions and graph-based ML models (functional + technical)
Proven experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration
Strong knowledge and working experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases
(no leadership/commercial requirement at this band)
Preferred Experience

Well versed in Python, with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, and tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow)
Practical experience with NLP and/or Search techniques
Prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
You have team lead experience
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones.
You have external client-facing consulting experience
Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems

YOU ARE
As a hands-on Infrastructure Architect, you are an experienced engineer with several years in infrastructure engineering who now takes on more complex, higher-impact work designing and optimizing the AI and machine learning infrastructure that powers real-world applications. Working alongside senior architects and engineers — and increasingly leading your own workstreams — you apply proven skills in coding, testing, configuring, deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting AI systems and the infrastructure they run on. Day to day, you architect and optimize infrastructure components, write and review code and deployment scripts, design and tune cloud and on-premises compute resources such as GPU clusters and distributed training environments, deploy AI systems and models into production, and build and optimize data pipelines that feed AI and ML workflows. You optimize the computational stack for performance, cost, power, and scalability, monitor AI systems and infrastructure health across both InfraOps and MLOps disciplines, perform AI monitoring to track model and system performance, and independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the stack. You also mentor junior engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and help establish best practices. This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role where you apply and deepen your expertise across modern tools and platforms — including container orchestration, model serving, CI/CD pipelines, InfraOps, MLOps, and AI monitoring — while making meaningful contributions to infrastructure that enables AI-driven business outcomes.
THE WORK
Write, review, and debug code, scripts, and infrastructure-as-code for AI infrastructure, automation, and tooling, setting standards for quality across the team.
Architect, configure, and provision compute resources across cloud and on-premises environments, including GPU clusters and distributed training setups, optimizing for performance and utilization.
Design and maintain deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, repeatable releases of AI systems, models, and applications.

Architect and optimize the computational stack for performance, power, cost, and scalability, balancing trade-offs against business goals.
Evaluate and select tools, frameworks, and platforms, making recommendations that shape the infrastructure roadmap.
Integrate AI models and systems into existing enterprise systems, ensuring interoperability, security, and regulatory compliance.

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
